text: 不等同降息！权威解读央行货币政策目标利率择机“换锚” 将研究择机把央行公开市场主要操作品种的期限切换为隔夜，公开市场隔夜回购利率将相应成为主要政策利率。
text_en: Not equivalent to a rate cut! Authoritative interpretation: PBOC to opportunistically switch the anchor of its monetary policy target rate; will study switching the tenor of the PBOC's main open market operation instrument to overnight at an appropriate time, and the overnight repo rate in open market operations will accordingly become the main policy rate.
